howto: Tap the rock to dig stones. Every stone takes you deeper.
Spend stones on a better pickaxe (more per tap) and auto-miners (stones every second, even while you are away).
Deeper tiers have richer ore. Past 1000m, Prestige for gems that add 3% mining power each.
tips: Tap quickly to build Flow: every 10 in a row pays a bonus.
Dynamite makes all digging 10 times faster for 20 seconds.
Each new ore tier doubles the value of every stone.
Gems also buy permanent upgrades like the Eternal Pick.
Use the ×10 and MAX buttons to hire miners in bulk.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a button and press Enter or Space. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the rock and the shop buttons

difficulty: An idle curve: pickaxes cost 60% more each level and miners 50% more each, while ore gets richer every tier from Stone at 0m to Void at 5000m.

cheats.effect: Stone rain: a big pile of stones (ten minutes' worth, at least 1000)
Big boom: free dynamite, ×10 digging for 60 seconds

features.offline-earnings: Welcome back card: stones your miners dug while away at 50% rate, up to 8 hours
features.upgrade-tree: Pickaxe levels, auto-miners, dynamite and four gem upgrades
features.prestige-or-next-goal: Prestige for gems (+3% mining each) plus the next ore tier and its depth shown under the rock
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first visit: dig, shop and dynamite; replay with Learn to play
features.results: Prestige card with stones this run, depth reached, total gems and the new multiplier
